subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: make the whole story. Only the corresponding numbers of the sentences need to be written. 18 = 8 (a) What did you learn? (b) Thanks Dad for showing me how poor we are. (c) Dad said did you see how poor they are. (d) We have lantern, at night, they have stars. (e) We have one dog, they have four, we have pool, they have river. (f) He wanted to show how poor someone can be. (g) We have walls to protect us, they have friends. Then they headed. (h) They spent time on the farm of a poor family.  Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
